english.title: Person in control of aerodrome fail to permit officer to enter for inspection purposes
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in control of an aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AERODROME..), failed to permit an officer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFICER..), to enter upon and inspect the aerodrome and all goods and buildings thereon.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(2) and (4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
